fullPassage: The struggle to maintain one’s body weight has never been direr, as evidenced by the World Health Organization’s report that the global rate of adult obesity has doubled since 1990. One factor contributing to this propensity is the increasing size of food portions. Larger offerings in packaged food, like chocolate bars, and restaurant menu items, such as double patty burgers and upsized sides, are causing many people to consume more calories. According to dietitian Alice Gibson, this portion distortion has altered our diets because “we’ve become so accustomed to larger servings that a ‘normal’ portion is often much more food than we actually need.” It may seem like this conundrum would be solved by opting for low-calorie or low-fat alternatives. However, research shows that without strict portion control, we tend to eat more when choosing these options and consume unnecessary additional calories, further contributing to the growing obesity epidemic.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 strict와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
strict는 '엄격한'이라는 뜻으로, 그 반대는 '관대한, 느슨한'을 뜻하는 lenient
① harsh(가혹한) — 오히려 strict와 비슷한 의미축
② lenient(관대한) ✅ 정답 — strict의 반의어
③ careful(주의 깊은) — strict와 비슷한 뉘앙스로 반대가 아님
④ firm(단호한) — strict와 유사한 의미
det.tip: strict(엄격한) ↔ lenient(관대한)

questions.passage:
(A) The global <u>rate</u> of adult obesity has doubled, alarming health experts across many countries.
(B) Food critics were invited to <u>rate</u> each new dish on a scale from one to five.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 rate가 (A)의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
(A)의 rate는 '비율'이라는 뜻의 명사로 쓰였음
① Please rate the movie ❌ (B)처럼 '평가하다'는 동사
② a steady rate of breathing ❌ 시간당 '횟수/속도'를 뜻하는 명사로, '비율'과 다름
③ The unemployment rate ✅ 정답 — '실업률'처럼 전체 대비 '비율'을 뜻해 (A)와 동일
④ Judges will rate ❌ '평가하다'는 동사
det.tip: rate는 명사로 '비율', 동사로 '평가하다'로 쓰임. obesity rate(비만율) = 비율

ch: Please rate the movie right after you finish watching it in the theater.
The runner kept a steady rate of breathing throughout the long race.
The unemployment rate in the city rose sharply during last year.
Judges will rate every performance based on skill and creativity.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a situation in which a disease or something harmful spreads quickly to a large number of people"

det.analysis:
'질병이나 해로운 것이 많은 사람에게 빠르게 퍼지는 상황'이라는 정의는 epidemic(유행병)에 해당함
① remedy(해결책, 치료법) — 확산이 아니라 대책을 뜻함
② symptom(증상) — 병의 징후를 뜻해 정의와 다름
③ portion(1인분, 양) — 음식의 양을 뜻해 무관
④ epidemic(유행병) ✅ 정답 — 정의와 정확히 일치
det.tip: epidemic = 질병·해로운 것이 빠르게 널리 퍼지는 상황

questions.passage: One factor __________ (contribute) to this propensity is the increasing size of food portions. Larger offerings in packaged food, like chocolate bars, and restaurant menu items, such as double patty burgers and upsized sides, are causing many people to consume more calories.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 One factor를 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사 자리이므로 contribute를 contributing으로 바꿔야 함
det.analysis:
빈칸은 앞의 명사 One factor(한 가지 요인)를 뒤에서 수식하는 분사 자리임. '~에 기여하는'이라는 능동의 의미이므로 현재분사 contributing이 정답
동사 contribute를 그대로 두면 문장에 본동사 is와 함께 동사가 두 개가 되어 문법상 성립하지 않음
det.tip: 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미며 '~하는'의 능동 의미 → 현재분사(-ing). contribute → contributing

questions.passage: According to dietitian Alice Gibson, this portion distortion has altered our diets because we’ve become so accustomed to larger servings that a normal portion is often much more food than we actually need. It may seem like this conundrum would be __________ (solve) by opting for low-calorie or low-fat alternatives.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 빈칸 앞에 be동사(be)가 있고 문제가 '해결되는' 대상이므로 수동태 형태인 solved로 써야 함
det.analysis:
'would be __________ by ...' 구조에서 빈칸은 be동사와 함께 수동태를 이루어야 함. 난제(conundrum)는 해결'되는' 대상이므로 능동(solve)이 아닌 과거분사 solved가 정답
by 이하가 행위의 방법을 나타내는 것도 수동태의 단서임
det.tip: would be + 과거분사(p.p.) = 수동태. solve → solved

questions.passage: The struggle to maintain one’s body weight has never been direr, as evidenced by the World Health Organization’s report that the global rate of adult obesity has doubled since 1990. One factor contributing to this propensity is the increasing size of food portions. Larger offerings in packaged food, like chocolate bars, and restaurant menu items, such as double patty burgers and upsized sides, are causing many people to consume more calories. According to dietitian Alice Gibson, this portion distortion has altered our diets because “we’ve become so accustomed to larger servings that a ‘normal’ portion is often much more food than we actually need.” It may seem like this conundrum would be solved by opting for low-calorie or low-fat alternatives. However, research shows that without strict __________, we tend to eat more when choosing these options and consume unnecessary additional calories, further contributing to the growing obesity epidemic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
빈칸 앞뒤에서 '엄격한 ____이 없으면 더 먹게 된다'고 했으므로, 먹는 양을 조절하는 것을 뜻하는 portion control이 적절
① portion control(양 조절) ✅ 정답 — 큰 제공량 문제의 핵심 해법으로 글 전체가 다룬 개념
② calorie counting(칼로리 계산) — 본문이 강조한 '양' 조절과 초점이 다름
③ food labeling(식품 표시) — 본문에 언급되지 않은 개념
④ meal timing(식사 시간 조절) — 본문 흐름과 무관
det.tip: without strict ____ → 먹는 '양'을 조절하는 portion control

questions.passage: The struggle to maintain one’s body weight has never been direr, as evidenced by the World Health Organization’s report that the global rate of adult obesity has doubled since 1990. One factor contributing to this propensity is the increasing size of food portions. Larger offerings in packaged food, like chocolate bars, and restaurant menu items, such as double patty burgers and upsized sides, are causing many people to consume more calories. According to dietitian Alice Gibson, this __________ has altered our diets because “we’ve become so accustomed to larger servings that a ‘normal’ portion is often much more food than we actually need.” It may seem like this conundrum would be solved by opting for low-calorie or low-fat alternatives. However, research shows that without strict portion control, we tend to eat more when choosing these options and consume unnecessary additional calories, further contributing to the growing obesity epidemic.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: portion distortion=제공량 왜곡(정상 1인분에 대한 인식이 커지는 것)
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 '이 ____이 식습관을 바꿔서 큰 양에 익숙해졌다'고 설명하므로, 커진 제공량 때문에 정상량 인식이 왜곡됨을 뜻하는 portion distortion이 적절
① food shortage(식량 부족) — 큰 양에 익숙해진다는 문맥과 정반대
② portion distortion(제공량 왜곡) ✅ 정답 — 큰 서빙에 익숙해져 정상량 인식이 왜곡됨
③ calorie surplus(칼로리 잉여) — 결과의 일부일 뿐 '식습관을 바꾼' 원인 개념과 다름
④ weight gain(체중 증가) — 결과이지 식습관을 바꾸는 원인이 아님
det.tip: this ____ has altered our diets → 큰 양에 익숙해지게 만든 portion distortion(제공량 왜곡)
